name: tia_set_block_attribute
description: Set one allow-listed attribute of an OB in place (PlcBlock.SetAttribute; the block is not deleted or re-imported): CyclicTime (cyclic interrupt interval) and PhaseOffset of a cyclic interrupt OB, or PriorityNumber. Time values need an explicit unit 'ms' or 'us'; Openness and SimaticML store microseconds (100 ms = 100000 us). expected_current_value (same unit) makes the call fail with 'conflict' when the current value differs. The new value is read back; the project is not compiled or saved. F-CPU safety OBs are not supported.

attribute_name.description: Attribute to set. CyclicTime and PhaseOffset only on cyclic interrupt OBs (SecondaryType CyclicInterrupt).

value.description: New value as an integer, in 'unit' for CyclicTime and PhaseOffset. CyclicTime 1..60000 ms, PhaseOffset smaller than CyclicTime.

unit.description: Unit of value and expected_current_value: required for CyclicTime and PhaseOffset, must be omitted for PriorityNumber.

expected_current_value.description: Optional guard: the value you expect the attribute to have now, in the same unit.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

group_path.description: Exact block-group path, required when the block name is duplicated. Use an empty string for the root group.
